skills.name: solve_ft09_binary_level
skills.source:
def solve_ft09_binary_level(cells):
    """Try every binary setting of the supplied clickable tile centers."""
    start = levels()
    press(6)
    previous = 0
    for i in range(1, 1 << len(cells)):
        if levels() > start or not alive():
            return levels() > start
        gray = i ^ (i >> 1)
        bitmask = gray ^ previous
        bit = (bitmask & -bitmask).bit_length() - 1
        click(*cells[bit])
        previous = gray
        press(6)
    return levels() > start
skills.description: Exhausts all binary configurations of measured clickable tile centers using Gray-code traversal and submits each with action 6.
